text: {"outsider_clarity":4,"professional_relevance":4,"specificity":4,"novel_insight":3,"practical_usefulness":4,"emotional_tension":3,"conversation_potential":4,"shareability":3,"voice_authenticity":3,"gaps":["The recovery takeaway repeats across several paragraphs; tightening those repetitions would give the post more momentum.","The familiar sign-in-versus-recovery distinction is useful but offers limited additional insight beyond the documented tactic.","Phrases such as ‘That recommendation belongs alongside the recovery lesson’ sound editorial and dilute the direct, conversational voice."],"rationale":"The post is grounded, relevant and practically useful, but repetition, restrained human stakes and occasional editorial phrasing keep it adequate to strong rather than exceptional."}
